Hymn 178: O Lord of Hosts
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: E-flat Major
Composer: Edwin F. Parry
Lyricist/Text Author: Andrew Dalrymple
Category: Sacrament

This is hymn number 178 titled "O Lord of Hosts" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in E-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Edwin F. Parry and the lyrics were written by Andrew Dalrymple.
This hymn is categorized under: Sacrament.
